summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 14, 2026. Stockholders voted on nine routine items, including auditor ratification, director re-elections, and a share consolidation (8:1 reverse split) of Class A and Class B ordinary shares. No extraordinary special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review was disclosed. The filing is a standard post-meeting report without any deal-related terms or structural changes beyond the capital reorganisation. There are no risk-arb angles, advisors, or regulatory clocks to monitor.
